digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and structured output retry architecture
propositions: All structured-output consumers (library, CLI, MCP, in-tree) must route exclusively through the single PydanticAIRunner facade and one-operation path, verified by mode-resolving AST census and single-sourced dispatch contract test

Output repair transitions from bespoke fresh-Agent retry loop to in-Agent bounded retry (retries={"output":N}), yielding exactly one outer agent.run_sync on well-formed first response and two only on bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade

The structured_retry_limit knob is retained as output-retry-allowance cap; structured_retry_limit=0 produces zero output-repair retries and zero UsageLimits addend, preserving single-shot fail-safe for overlap/judge batch abstain

Request budget seeded once from output_retry_allowance (N=min(OUTPUT_RETRIES, max(0, structured_retry_limit))) feeds both Agent retries and constructed UsageLimits addend, guaranteeing request budget never trips before output-retry counter

Provider fallback eligibility, candidate order, output-mode policy, tool surfaces, timeout/transport limits, provenance, and serialized output shapes remain unchanged and pass historical regression suites

All autonomous acceptance criteria (single-sourced dispatch census, RP-01 behavior matrix, no-bespoke-loop oracle, structured_retry_limit=0 single-shot test, fallback/shape regressions, lint/typecheck/module-size gates, documented contracts) pass; live Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries deferred to credentialed operator
